summary: Add the required visual support and explain how repeated grating measurements can yield wavelength from a graph.

improvements.why: The figures gate reports no diagram for outcome 9702-8.4.2; a wave visual can mark the wavelength whose value the grating experiment determines.
improvements.what: Use the supported wave type to show and label one wavelength of monochromatic light; embed it in the note and connect its label to the wavelength calculated from $d\sin\theta=n\lambda$.

improvements.why: The method recommends several diffraction orders but gives no way to use a best-fit graph; Cambridge's 2025 Paper 12 question 29 assesses this interpretation.
improvements.what: Add a short optional graph method: plot order $n$ vertically against $\sin\theta$ horizontally, so gradient $G=d/\lambda$ and $\lambda=d/G$. State axes and that $d$ comes from line density. Paraphrase the official question rather than copying it.
